marketplace.name: dev-digest-ai-marketplace
marketplace.description: Internal AI Harness marketplace for the DevDigest team: skills, agents, commands and hooks for Claude Code

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Pull request review against team standards: security, tests, readability
plugins.author: Oleh Demskyi

Changed: Skill `review-pr` renamed to `pr-review`; the old invocation no longer works
Added: Agent `security-reviewer` for a separate check of secrets and unsafe dependencies

Fixed: Review no longer comments on generated files in `dist/`

Added: Command `/code-review:summary`: a short PR summary for the description

plugins.name: core-conventions
plugins.description: Shared team conventions: commit style, branch names, repository structure
plugins.author: DevDigest Team

Added: Hook checks the commit message format before `git commit`

plugins.name: jira-workflow
plugins.description: Work with Jira tickets from Claude Code: create them, update statuses, link them to branches
plugins.author: DevDigest Team

Added: First release: skill `ticket-from-branch`, command `/jira-workflow:status`, Jira MCP server

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec-driven development: from spec to code and review
plugins.author: DevDigest Team

Added: Agent `spec-critic` finds contradictions and gaps in a spec
Fixed: Skill `write-spec` no longer duplicates the "Open questions" section

plugins.name: testing-toolkit
plugins.description: Generates unit and e2e tests, finds uncovered branches, analyzes CI failures
plugins.author: DevDigest Team

plugins.name: onboarding-helper
plugins.description: Helps new team members find their way around repositories and processes
plugins.author: Platform Team

artifacts.name: pr-review
artifacts.description: Full PR review against the team checklist: security, tests, readability, naming

artifacts.name: security-reviewer
artifacts.description: Dedicated agent that looks for secrets, unsafe dependencies and injections in the diff

artifacts.name: summary
artifacts.description: Short summary of PR changes for the description

artifacts.name: commit-message
artifacts.description: Writes a commit message following the team convention

artifacts.name: branch-name
artifacts.description: Suggests a branch name from the ticket number and description

artifacts.name: PreToolUse · Bash
artifacts.description: Checks the commit message format before git commit

artifacts.name: ticket-from-branch
artifacts.description: Finds the Jira ticket by the current branch name and pulls its description into context

artifacts.name: status
artifacts.description: Changes the status of the current Jira ticket

artifacts.name: write-spec
artifacts.description: Writes a feature spec from the team template: goal, features, acceptance criteria, open questions

artifacts.name: spec-to-tasks
artifacts.description: Breaks a spec into tasks with estimates and dependencies

artifacts.name: spec-critic
artifacts.description: Finds contradictions, gaps and untestable criteria in a spec

artifacts.name: write-tests
artifacts.description: Generates unit tests for changed code in the style of existing tests

artifacts.name: coverage-hunter
artifacts.description: Finds code branches not covered by tests and suggests test cases
